_comment: env/lido module's own STEPS_FILE override (docs/tasks/E5-lido.md) -- lido-core's own scripts/scratch/steps.json (tag v4.0.1), with the last three entries dropped. STEPS_FILE is itself a documented, overridable input (scripts/utils/migration-env.sh's load_env_var STEPS_FILE), so this is supplying an input, not editing lido-core (docs/ENVIRONMENT.md section 4). Dropped, and why: 0135-deploy-staking-modules clones lidofinance/community-staking-module and drives its deploy through `just`, unconditionally for any network but hardhat's in-process one (scripts/utils/staking-modules.ts's deployStakingModules); 0140-plug-staking-modules's enableExternalModule then needs to act as the Aragon Agent for the freshly-deployed Community Staking Module and Curated Module v2, and does so by calling lib/account.ts's impersonate() -- `${networkName}_impersonateAccount`, an Anvil/Hardhat cheatcode. Reproduced against this environment's own anvil-based throwaway test: HardhatError HH103 'Account ... is not managed by the node', because this environment's hardhat network config supplies an explicit deployer private key (LOCAL_DEVNET_PK, needed to sign real transactions at all) rather than 'remote' accounts, so Hardhat's LocalAccountsProvider intercepts before the node is ever asked to impersonate -- and real geth implements no such RPC method regardless. Neither Community Staking Module nor Curated Module v2 is named in docs/scratch-deploy.md or in docs/tasks/E5-lido.md's Goal (stETH, wstETH, locator, oracle contracts only); both are out of scope per that brief's own 'staking modules beyond what the scratch deploy creates' line. 0150-transfer-roles is also dropped: it only hands OZ AccessControl admin roles and OssifiableProxy admin control from the deployer to the Agent, which none of docs/ENVIRONMENT.md section 6's lido postconditions read.
